script: Now write the proposal: the problem, the eight posts, the delivery dates, the price, the payment method and the revisions. If the shop says the price is too high, do not cut your rate. Offer six posts instead of eight. You protect your time, and the client keeps control of the budget. This is how professional freelancers stay in business. Say no politely when an offer is below your minimum. A clear no is better than a resentful yes. Put every agreement in writing, even in a short chat message. Keep a list of your own minimum rate per hour, and decide it before you talk to clients, so that you are not pressured in the moment.
